# TOON specification fixtures

The JSON files under `encode/` are unmodified copies of the language-agnostic
encode fixtures published by the `toon-format/spec` project at tag `v4.1.1`
(commit `62f16b369408180f1faf1cba7da1b46d1f336f12`):

https://github.com/toon-format/spec/tree/v4.1.1/tests/fixtures/encode

They are redistributed under that project's MIT license, reproduced in
`LICENSE`. The fixtures exercise the format specification; they are not
runtime inputs and are not embedded in the Hesape library.
